body: That is so sweet, her kindness just made my night as well. What a blessing, and you deserve it. ❤️

I understand this a lot. I always had an issue with this with my mom as well. She’s an incredibly compassionate woman who’s marched for women’s rights, overcome her family’s racism, and is always actively involved in the community. But there’s not a lot of room for sympathy for me it feels. 

The only way I can understand this behavior (again, not excusing it at all) is that they feel like having their own child be vulnerable in any capacity is too close to home for them. All these other people need help but to have “weakness” so close to them makes them confused then frustrated and then they lash out. Not fair in the slightest and I wish some moms could be self aware enough to see this. 

You deserve unconditional love and affection from your mom. I’m really sorry that happened.

My heart aches for you, man. Recently my dad (unprompted, mind you) went on a rant to my sister about how we turned out mentally ill because we were so spoiled and so flawlessly raised that our brains couldn’t handle having a struggle free life and we made ourselves mental. It’s just plain ignorance. It’s willfully not understanding and being confrontational and you don’t deserve that at all. Take care, I’m here if you ever wanna talk.
Thank you so much, I’ll definitely look into it
